tools.name: list_clinics
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to list veterinary clinics accessible to the connected Veterical account and retrieve their identifiers for subsequent administrative reads. Returns each clinic's id, name, currency, default language and timezone, 20 per page by default. Not for finding a pet, owner or a

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to read the name, currency, language, timezone and edit time of one Veterical clinic selected by its identifier. Returns the clinic's name, currency, default language, timezone and last edit time; an id outside the organization returns not-found. Not for free appointment

tools.name: get_clinic_availability
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to summarize unassigned online-booking capacity for one Veterical clinic as daily slot counts and first/last slot times. Returns the open online-booking slots per day for one clinic: how many, plus the first start and last end time. Covers the next days that have opening

tools.name: list_clinic_providers
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to list the display names of staff offered by one Veterical clinic for online booking. Returns up to 100 staff display names for one clinic (no contact details, roles or pet data). Not for staff days off or vacations.

tools.name: get_clinic_schedule_summary
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to count scheduled records by UTC day for one Veterical clinic and a bounded date range, including canceled records. Returns appointment counts per UTC day for one clinic, canceled ones included, for the next 7 days by default and at most 31 days; counting stops at 100.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to list non-appointment calendar blocks and additional opening periods for a Veterical clinic. Returns each block or extra opening with start, end, all-day flag, scope (clinic, staff or room) and type, without titles, notes or names. Not for appointments.

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to read anonymous numeric catalog rows from a Veterical clinic to inspect configured prices, durations and edit times. Returns price, duration where recorded and last edit time per catalog row, without treatment names. Not for the price of a specific named treatment.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to aggregate one bounded page of recorded Veterical payments by currency and status; this is not a full revenue or settlement report. Returns totals and counts by currency and status for one page of payments, newest first (20 by default), with a cursor for the rest (no c

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to read the subscription plan, status, billing frequency and configured capacity limits for a Veterical clinic. Returns plan name, status, billing frequency and plan caps per subscription; caps are limits, not usage. Not for invoices or amounts billed.

tools.name: show_clinic_overview
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to render a read-only administrative overview for one Veterical clinic selected by its identifier. Returns an overview card with the clinic's details, appointment counts for the next 7 days, how many staff can be booked, open online-booking slots and up to 12 catalog pri

tools.name: open_veterical
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to open the Veterical clinic-selection sidebar when the user requests an interactive clinic browser. Returns up to 100 clinics to start from (no pet, owner, appointment or clinical data). Not for booking appointments, editing records or medical decisions.
